title: Procedure for determination of request for certificate of appropriateness.
officialText: The commission shall hold a public hearing on each request for a certificate of appropriateness. Except as otherwise provided in section 25-309 of this chapter, the commission shall make its determination as to such request within ninety days after filing thereof.
